text:
Tara (CSM): heads-up — AcmeHealth flagged renewal risk. onboarding stalled, usage down ~40% w/w. they mentioned considering a downgrade if we don’t show quick wins. renewal in 6 weeks. need a short save plan + enablement push. :eyes:
Miguel (CS Lead): copy — what’s ARR and who’s the exec sponsor? can we get a friction hotlist?
Tara (CSM): ARR ~ $210k ARR. exec sponsor is VP Product (Nora). main friction: adoption across care teams, SSO flakiness early in pilot, and no internal training. billing/PO is progressing but they want justification.
Rahul (Data): quick numbers from console: weekly_active_users dropped from 85 -> 51 over last 7 days. average session length down 22%. most churn in nurses cohort (role_id: RN). query used: `SELECT role, wau FROM usage_weekly WHERE account_id=acme LIMIT 4`
Jess (Enablement): plan idea — 2-week "activation burst": 1) targeted enablement for nurses (30‑min cohort session), 2) run 1x co-browsing session with Nora + power users, 3) provide 10 sandbox tokens and a tailored checklist, 4) offer a one‑time onboarding concierge (free) to re-seed adoption. can we pair that with a short success metric (WAU + task completion)? :handshake:
Linh (Support): we still have an open SSO ticket (SUP-4122). I can prioritise an on-call engineer to do a config review + session this week. will ping infra and set a 48h SLA for investigation.
Miguel (CS Lead): sounds good. propose this sequence (owners + deadlines): - Day 0: send exec alignment note (Tara) - Day 1: schedule nurse cohort + co-browse (Jess) - Day 2-3: SSO deep-dive (Linh) - Day 4-10: activation burst + monitoring (Rahul) - Day 12: renewal check-in w/ Nora (Miguel)
Tara (CSM): I can send the exec alignment note today. draft outline: context, usage dip, proposed activation burst, ask for 2 weeks to prove, ask for one champion session with Nora. happy to share draft here for quick edits.
Rahul (Data): I’ll add a micro-dashboard and a live WAU widget you can embed in the note. ETA: 24h. metric targets: +25% WAU and +15% session length within 10 days.
Jess (Enablement): draft checklist for nurse session (short bullets): - 3 workflows (triage, handoff, discharge) - 5 minute quick wins demo - 1 self-serve playbook - measurements & next steps. I’ll drop a calendar invite template in #engagement-templates.
Miguel (CS Lead): pricing safety net? propose a one-time 20% credit on next invoice if targets not met, plus 30-day extension on pilot features. finance ok with that?
Tara (CSM): finance signalled flexibility for one-off credits on at-risk renewals up to 20%. I’ll flag legal for updated T&Cs if needed.
CS-Bot: tagging account: acmehealth | risk: high | owner: Tara (CSM) — please update the account risk field after each milestone.
Linh (Support): opening SUP-4225 to track the concierge config work and SSO escalation, linking SUP-4122. will post updates there.
Miguel (CS Lead): action owners agreed. Tara — send exec note + attach Rahul’s mini-dashboard. Jess — schedule cohort + invite list. Linh — priority SSO work. Rahul — dashboard + live metric feed. I'll run the renewal play check on day 12.
Tara (CSM): will send note before EOD PST. tagging @Jess @Linh @Rahul for readiness. thanks team — keep replies here for audit and handoff. :rocket:
